March 15, 1994
To: Tom Humber
Source:
Windy Leavell
Fr: Eric Schippers

Re: NSA D.C. Recruitment Drive
/www.
Despite four days of rain, sleet and snow storms which hampered our efforts, we are
happy to report the D.C. Recruitment Drive was an unqualified success, yielding 6,178
new members at a cost per member of approximately S4.70. Please note, we still expect
300 - 400 completed membership application forms to arrive today or tomorrow from
Virginia Beach, Va., and Baltimore, Md. This will not affect our final budget which, after
taking into account all professional services and out-of-pocket expenses, will not exceed
Please find attached our completed memberahip application forms. These have been spot-
checked for illegible handwriting, duplicates and false names (i.e., Elvis Presley, Socks
Clinton, etc.) As these newest members of the NSA are entered into the database, we
recommend they be specially coded to identify those members who were directly recruited
by our people, versus those solicited by direct mail. This will allow the NSA to track the
viability of these new members, as to their activism, enthusiasm, membership renewal rate,
etc.
Due to the success of our initial "test" run in Washington, we strongly recommend an
extension to include several targeted sights in Maryland. A grent opportunity exists there
due to the recent administrative order banning smoking in all public places. Our initial
tests of recruiting members in the Baltimore-area proved successful. There is also the
potential to recruit both civilian and military NSA members in Annapolis.
